context:
Goal: pull requests #2906, #2904 and #2778 get their review records posted and merge.
Problem (rule): the merge tool refuses a fix check that starts at an earlier reviewed head when lane commits come after it, because decision pr-review-record says a fix check starts at that head, never at a later commit, so changing it is your call.
Based on (measured): the lane's record for #2906 at 66363ce4 is refused; draft PR #3637 has 2 red cases for the change; tests ReviewFixAfterMainMerge (d) and (h) pin the current rule (consultant, 19:58 CST Nov 17, not re-run by triage).
Departs from: pr-review-record's fix-check order — a fix check may start at any earlier reviewed head that is an ancestor of the live head.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; draft PR #3637 stays a draft and nothing else waits on it.

lastAnswer.note: isnt there more nuance to this? i think we try to keep checkouts / heads more updated real time so that way it avoids this, but really if there's no problem with this i'm completely fine iwth A

options.how: The merge tool accepts a fix check that starts at an earlier reviewed head that is an ancestor of the live head; draft PR #3637 is finished and the three records post. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo
options.label: Change the rule: a fix check reviews all commits since the last reviewed head
options.lose: One fix check covers more than one fix.

options.how: No rule change; the three lanes each run review again from round 1.
options.label: Keep the rule: each of the three lanes restarts at round 1 on its live head (recommended)

reply: Closed on your pick a (14:40 CST). This item was already built: draft PR 3637 merged at 01:06:44 CST Nov 18 (merge commit 9ac3c66527a4) under your earlier pick of a (step fix-check-chains-from-descendant, done), and I left the item open by mistake. On the root cause you name: no step covers 'a lane pushes commits after a review' as a whole. Pieces exist: reviewed-head-push-ask (the guard asks before a push past a reviewed head, doing), ready-records-push-keeps-record-head (doing), and round-one-reset (ready). I have asked the consultant whether it belongs in the next goal.
short: Fix check from an earlier reviewed head

title: May a fix check start at an earlier reviewed head, so three stuck pull requests merge without restarting review?
why: b keeps the merge tool as ruled, and a widens what the shared tool accepts; the price of b is three extra review rounds. Recommended by the consultant after his correction, not owner-typed.
